initialization: Both arms start at original C146 fixed step12; routed experts are three identical copies. Both reset moments.
router: u=V@(raw-prepared) from prewrite coordinates only; training84 population mean/std with floor1e-8; deterministic three prototypes: first registered row then farthest-first, exact ties use first registry row; eight fixed Lloyd iterations, empty clusters retain old prototype; softmax(-mean((z-center)^2)/2). No case, state ID, endpoint label or final failure membership enters routing.
router_role: Fixed training-side prewrite routing, not learned online addressing, an established geometric atlas or a class lookup. All valid new contexts can be routed; no excluded-input result is measured.
coefficient_map: global a; routed a(z)=weights(z)@A with three bounded local vectors. No post-mixture clipping; convex weights preserve coefficient bound.
regularization: Same .001*mean(effective_a(z)^2) per state in both arms, not mean of all expert coefficients.
objective_ties: Average exact ties within response coordinates and across84 states; finite weighted objective, no monotonicity or feasibility guarantee.
freeze: Both fixed step12 heads and all336 proposals sealed before two-round672 native endpoints. No arm/step/cluster/seed selection or deployment.
originals: Rehash original C147,C146,C145,C143 and rerun delivered C147 arithmetic audit before model load; other linked original ZIPs not reopened.
pass_rule: Report separate fixed-final qualification for each arm: all84 original native gates in both rounds and replay/repeat consistency. Any incomplete branch invalidates complete comparison. No preferred arm is selected.
derivative_path: Scalar AD to effective36 coefficient leaf; exact fixed linear routing pullback to108 parameters, not a model-response Jacobian. Effective coefficients committed with the same NumPy map in training and frozen inference.
scope: Offline two-arm architecture-and-capacity comparison on exposed84 training states only. A routed advantage cannot isolate routing from increased parameter count or optimizer geometry. No unseen/excluded generalisation, complete geometric atlas, true-gradient certification, convergence, eventual closure or model-internal control claim. Actual GPT2 CPU endpoints are required for production qualification.
